verdicts.reason: A scatters the elements across the strip: the small headline sits top-centre with CITRINE stacked under it (the brand now falls below the message), the Find a Store pill is stranded bottom-left against a decorative circle, and the bag is a tiny isolated chip at the far right, so the reading order is jumbled and the headline has little presence. B reads cleanly left to right (bag, then a dominant headline, then the CTA) with clear hierarchy, but the bag is shrunk to an illegible thumbnail, the CITRINE wordmark is crushed to unreadable micro-text under the button, and the right cluster is cramped against the edge.
